Token counts come from the API's own usage fields (including image tokens and prompt-cache hits). Prices from pricing.json — verify against the provider's current price list. Repeat runs of an unchanged plan are served from the local response cache at $0.

6 · Method

  1. Explore (no LLM): enter the demo, discover views, record fields, buttons, tables and stable selectors.
  2. Plan (plan model): extract explicit + implied requirements from the PRD, then design normal / negative / edge scenarios grounded in the explored site map.
  3. Execute: one fresh browser context per scenario; self-healing element resolution (test id → label → placeholder → ARIA role → text → fast-model pick from live DOM); network-idle + DOM-quiet waits instead of sleeps.
  4. Verify: deterministic oracles over captured before/after values, DOM state, validation messages and HTTP traffic. A success toast is never accepted as proof.
  5. Confirm: failures re-run once in a clean context (flake filter), then reviewed by the judge model, which can downgrade test-design mistakes to UNVERIFIED.
